requirements.title: IACHAR returns ISO/IEC 646 positions for ASCII characters
requirements.definition: For C in the ISO/IEC 646:1991 International Reference Version collating sequence, IACHAR(C) is the nonnegative position of C and is at most 127.

pending.IACHAR-ASCII-position-exact: Assert exact discriminating values IACHAR(' ')==32, IACHAR('0')==48, IACHAR('A')==65, and IACHAR('X')==88; mutation swaps characters or expected positions.
pending.IACHAR-ASCII-result-range: For ASCII controls ' ', '0', 'A', and 'X', assert each result is between 0 and 127 and use a non-ASCII companion only under the processor-dependent facet.

requirements.title: IACHAR results are consistent with lexical comparison intrinsics
requirements.definition: IACHAR results are consistent with LGE, LGT, LLE, and LLT comparisons; for example, LLE(C,D) true implies IACHAR(C) <= IACHAR(D).

pending.IACHAR-LLE-implies-code-le: Use ASCII pairs ('A','B') and ('0','A'); assert LLE is true and IACHAR(left) <= IACHAR(right), then mutate pair order.
pending.IACHAR-LGE-implies-code-ge: Use ASCII pairs ('B','A') and ('X','0'); assert LGE is true and IACHAR(left) >= IACHAR(right), then mutate pair order.
pending.IACHAR-equality-consistent-codes: Use identical character pairs such as ('X','X') to assert LLE and LGE are true and IACHAR codes compare equal, with different-character companions to avoid vacuous equality-only coverage.
